column1: # ALL camera-vs-commanded-reference rate errors. The motor is a PULSE-DERIVED COMMANDED REFERENCE, not ground truth.
# RAW_* : primary, plain finite difference, unsmoothed
# SG_*  : SECONDARY DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, frozen Savitzky-Golay 1.00 s / order 2 / zero phase, identical for all axes, not tuned per axis. NEVER a RAW accuracy.
# DISPSCALE_* : rate-SCALE metric (total travel / elapsed time per leg). NOT an instantaneous rate RMSE.
# Axes are NOT comparable with each other: rate ranges, travel and frame rates differ.
